text:
maria: Heads-up — eu-west-3 GPU pool is throwing node evictions + 5xx spikes since 03:20 UTC. Autoscaler loop stuck, pending pods backlog ~120. RTTs up. tagging @oncall @ethan

ethan: On it. Seeing noisy-neighbor OOM on several p4d nodes; kube attach errors (volume attach timeout). Starting cordon/drain on eu-west-3a to isolate.

gslb-bot: ALERT: gslb.policy('soft-fallback') triggered: region_weight(eu-west-3)=0.55 -> 0.42 due to capacity pressure. Recommend progressive shift or weight override.

liu: We should avoid a hard evac to NA (egress cost spike). Proposal: relax AZ-affinity (allow cross-AZ within region) + increase fallback threshold from 0.5 -> 0.65 so GSLB nudges traffic earlier. Do stepwise weight moves: 10% every 5m, prefer eu-central as primary sink, NA only if eu capacity exhausted.

monica: +1. Also enable KV-prefix caching & aggressive prefix reuse for EU customers during shift to blunt token churn. That reduces per-token pressure while we rebalance.

ethan: Plan I'm executing now: 1) update gslb policy 'soft-fallback' threshold=0.65 2) apply weight deltas: eu-central +0.07, eu-west-2 +0.03, na-west +0.02 in 2m increments (total 10%/step) 3) set DNS TTL to 60s for affected prefixes 4) watch 5xx/latency dashboards and rollback on >10% error increase.

maria: Runbook note — control-plane API to update policy (example):
```bash
curl -X POST https://control.redwood.internal/gslb/policies/soft-fallback \ 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $OP_TOKEN' \ 
  -d '{"fallback_threshold":0.65, "step_pct":0.10, "step_interval_s":120}'
```

deploy-bot: gslb.policy.update started by ethan (req_id=xyz123, policy=soft-fallback, from=0.50->0.65)

rachel: watching cost dashboard — if more than ~30% traffic spills to NA for >30m we hit the next billing slab for egress/instances. Please minimize NA as last resort and ping me if we cross 20% spill.

ethan: policy apply complete, first weight nudge executed. Metrics: 5xx down ~34%, p95 latency stable, pending pods dropped from 120 -> 48. Continuing step schedule (next in ~2m).

maria: Thanks — keeping this thread live. If drains finish and nodes recover we'll re-tighten affinity and lower fallback threshold. Will escalate to infra-oncall if errors rise again.
